notes.title: Baptising the nations
notes.intro: Jesus sends his followers to make disciples, baptising and teaching. Churches agree on the command but differ on who should be baptised.

views.label: Baptise believers and their children
views.summary: Many churches baptise infants of Christian families as part of making disciples, followed by teaching.
views.source: Catechism of the Catholic Church 1250–1252; Westminster Confession 28.4

views.label: Baptise those who have become disciples
views.summary: Others note that the order is “make disciples… baptising them,” and baptise only those who profess faith.
views.source: Baptist Faith and Message (2000), Article VII

notes.common: Almost all churches baptise in the name of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit, as here.
